messages:
deploy-bot: staged rollout scheduled: service=prompt-router, from=redwood/router-v2.2.3 to=redwood/router-v2.3.0, target=6% (eu-west), rollout_id=rl-7010, change_window=2026-03-26T14:00Z..15:00Z
pm: release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/router-2.3.0. Main: improved prefix caching and shard-routing tweak.
nana: is this using cache-ttl tweak? any runtime flags?
chris: yes, cache.ttl=45s for canary, and routing.shuffle=false (canary-only). Perf doc in notes.
sre-oncall: SRE watches: p95/p99 latency, 5xx, cache.hit_rate, kvcache.evictions. Auto-rollback rule: 5xx > 0.5% for 8m OR cache.hit_rate drop > 8% for 10m -> rollback.
infra: pinning canary to eu-west-1a to reduce noise.
deploy-bot: shifting traffic to 6% eu-west. phase=running.
chris: initial metrics: cache.hit_rate dipped 3% immediately after shift. not alarming.
sre-oncall: seeing small p99 bump (+20%). 5xx stable at 0.05%. tracing shows a short flurry of cache-miss amplification on route /v1/route.
nana: can we limit canary concurrency to 6 and enable prefretch=false for canary to reduce miss amplification?
sre-oncall: applying override: concurrency=6 and prefretch=false for rl-7010.
deploy-bot: updated rollout config: overrides applied for rl-7010.
chris: after override cache.hit_rate recovering; p99 trending down.
pm: Decision: HOLD at 6% for 25m. If stable, ramp to 25%. If cache.hit_rate drops > 8% or 5xx crosses threshold -> rollback.
nana: opening GH-5010 to investigate routing shuffle edge-case.
infra: node pin done; observability should reflect changes in ~90s.
sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards and added alert to #eng-oncall with playbook.
deploy-bot: phase=paused (manual_hold) rollout_id=rl-7010 current_pct=6 note=concurrency-limited+prefetch-disabled.
pm: thanks all  next update 14:25Z or earlier on signal. If anyone needs an immediate rollback, reply exactly "rollback" in this thread.
